narrative_chain.step: Sarah reaches out to Mark (cautious hope).
narrative_chain.consequence: Mark flinches and suppresses an attempt to speak.
narrative_chain.subtext: Fear of exposure overcomes desire for connection.

narrative_chain.consequence: Mark types a message but deletes it, then lies "Just tired."
narrative_chain.subtext: The deleted truth is the wall between them.

narrative_chain.step: Sarah asks if she is the problem.
narrative_chain.consequence: Mark aligns dishes on the table to avoid eye contact.
Mark turns to the wall, leaving her hand suspended in empty space.
